verdict.rationale: The first-party LangChain docs document MCPAdapter, which discovers an MCP server's tools and adapts them into LangChain tools, and community evidence says LangChain tool abstractions are optional add-ons usable within LangGraph graphs. The documented consumer, however, is "LangChain agents", not LangGraph itself, so LangGraph-native MCP client support is only implied. missing for 10: LangGraph-specific docs for connecting MCP servers to a graph or ToolNode, transport/auth configuration details, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: LangChain agents call tools defined on MCP servers through MCPAdapter, which discovers a server's tools and adapts them into LangChain tools.
tool abstractions are optional LangChain add-ons
